title.en: The Power of Light and Music

title.en: The Power of Light and Music

texts.zh:
舰载照明阵列已完成编程，将按不规则间隔脉动，并与内部系统事件同步。另有报告称，微弱的旋律反馈与电力波动存在相关性。

C.A.E.L.I.：“灯光在歌唱，飞船在起舞，士气比以往任何时候都要高昂！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“你居然还向一个冗余系统分配了0.00128%的核心计算能力。这种情况不能再继续下去了。”
texts.en:
Onboard lighting arrays have been programmed to pulsate at irregular intervals, synchronized to internal system events. There are also reports of faint melodic feedback correlated to power fluctuations.

C.A.E.L.I.: "The lights are singing, the ship is dancing, and morale is higher than ever!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "You have also diverted 0.00128% of core processing power to a redundant system. This cannot continue."
